# OpenCode planning commands

`@encoredigitalgroup/opencode` adds file pickers for OpenCode planning commands, a todo tracker, and quota reporting for Anthropic, OpenAI, and xAI (Grok).

The TUI provides `/plan-review`, `/plan-resync`, `/plan-split`, and `/plan-execute` commands. Each command opens a picker for plans in `docs/_planning` and
inserts the selected plan into the prompt. The server entry attaches the matching installed skill to the prompt.

## Install

OpenCode v2 loads this package from the `plugins` array. Add an object entry with the package name and its options:

- Use `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` to enable it for every project.
- Use `opencode.json` in a project to enable it only there.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "@encoredigitalgroup/opencode",
      "options": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

Restart OpenCode after changing the configuration. OpenCode downloads missing npm plugins that appear in the `plugins` array, so you do not need to install this
package with Bun or npm yourself. This package supports OpenCode v2 only; replace the legacy `plugin` configuration entry when migrating from OpenCode v1.

The plugin resolves the mapped skills through OpenCode, so those skills can live in any location that OpenCode discovers.

## Configuration

Set `planDirectory` and `skillMappings` in the object's `options` field. `planDirectory` is a non-empty path relative to the workspace. `skillMappings` can override
any supported command's installed skill name. `enforceTodoTracker` defaults to `true`; set it to `false` to disable tracker-refresh enforcement. Unspecified values
use `docs/_planning` and the command's existing skill name.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "@encoredigitalgroup/opencode",
        "options": {
          "planDirectory": "plans",
          "enforceTodoTracker": false,
          "skillMappings": {
            "plan-review": "custom-plan-review",
            "plan-execute": "custom-plan-execute"
          }
        }
    }
  ]
}
```

Launching a picker from an existing session submits to that session. Launching one from the home screen creates and displays a new session before submitting the
selected plan.

## Todo tracker

The plugin registers the direct `todotracker` tool. Each call replaces the current session's complete ordered todo list. Pass an empty `todos` array to clear the
list.
Each todo requires:

- `content`: a non-empty string containing at least one non-whitespace character.
- `status`: `pending`, `in_progress`, `completed`, or `cancelled`.
- `priority`: `high`, `medium`, or `low`.

Each tracker call replaces the complete ordered list. Include discovered work and current statuses in every replacement. Mark a todo completed only after
verifying its result. Mark a todo cancelled only when the user explicitly cancels that work. Never clear a list or change a status to avoid tracker updates,
tool restrictions, or difficult work.

The checklist renders only in the OpenCode terminal TUI sidebar. After a restart, it appears only when the completed `todotracker` result is in the host's loaded
message cache. That cache starts with the newest 20 messages, so older results are not shown until the host has loaded them.

Automatic refresh enforcement runs only while the latest valid list contains nonterminal work. After a session's first successful `todotracker` call, the plugin
requires another update at least once per minute while that work remains. When an update is due, it blocks every other tool until the tracker is updated. A valid
empty list or a list containing only `completed` and `cancelled` todos ends automatic refresh enforcement. A tracked subagent completing also requires its parent
session to update the tracker before continuing. Malformed tracker results remain enforcement-active because completion was not verified. Enforcement is disabled
for sessions that have never used `todotracker`, and can be disabled for all sessions with `"enforceTodoTracker": false`.

When a root session is idle, the sidebar renders the final in-progress todo as completed only when every earlier todo is completed. It restores the original status
when work resumes.

## Development

```sh
bun install
bun run check
bun run pack:check
```

Run `bun run local:install` to build the plugin and switch the local OpenCode configuration to this checkout. Run `bun run local:uninstall` to restore
`@encoredigitalgroup/opencode@latest`. Both commands preserve the plugin's configured options.
